title: Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1997

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend‑the
Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 17th May, 1997]
No.S.LEGIS.1(11)/97, dated 17‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Arid
Zone Development Authority (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Act II of 1985

SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend‑the
Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 17th May, 1997]
No.S.LEGIS.1(11)/97, dated 17‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Sindh Act II of 1985.‑‑In the Sindh Arid Zone Development
Authority Act, 1985, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 2‑‑
(i) in clause (i), before the
semi‑colon the words "and Vice‑Chairman" shall be added;
(ii) after clause (m), the
following new clause shall be added:‑‑
"(n) 'Vice‑Chairman'
means the Vice‑Chairman of the Authority.".

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act II of 1985

SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend‑the
Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 17th May, 1997]
No.S.LEGIS.1(11)/97, dated 17‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 5 of
Sindh Act II of 1985.‑‑In the said Act, in section 5‑‑
(i) in subsection (1) between‑the
word 'Chairman' and the word 'and' the comma and the words "a Vice‑Chairman
who shall be a Member of the Provincial Assembly" shall be inserted;
(ii) after subsection (1), the
following new subsection shall be inserted:‑‑
"(1‑A) The Office of
the Vice‑Chairman shall not be a wholetime office remunerated either by
salary or by fee.".

Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 17th May, 1997]
No.S.LEGIS.1(11)/97, dated 17‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
4. Insertion of new section 13‑A
in Sindh Act II of 1985.‑‑In the said Act, after section 13,
the following new section shall be inserted:‑‑
"13‑A.
Powers and functions of the Vice Chairman.‑‑The Vice Chairman
shall discharge such duties and perform such functions as may be assigned to
him by the Chairman".
